How to Use a Sauna

Shower first, sit on a towel, and stay 10 to 15 minutes, or less if it feels like too much. Step out to cool off with a cool shower or fresh air, rest, drink water, and repeat for another round if you like. Finish with a shower. Skip alcohol and leave if you feel dizzy or unwell.
